summary: Ohmyhome Limited, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer in real estate brokerage, filed a Form 6-K reporting a Regulation S private placement of 3,000,000 Class A ordinary shares plus 3,000,000 five-year warrants at a combined $1.30 per share and warrant, raising $3.9 million gross; the offering closed October 16, 2026. Warrants are immediately exercisable at $1.30, carry a 9.99% beneficial ownership blocker, and permit an unusual alternate cashless exercise of nine shares per warrant after seven days. Purchasers signed 12-month lock-ups. Proceeds fund working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and dilution mechanics.
